questions.question: How many years did Jeremiah 25 say the nations would serve Babylon?
What symbolic object did God give Jeremiah to make the nations drink in chapter 25?
options: The scroll of the words of his judgment
The cup of the wine of his wrath
The yoke of the king of Babylon
The sword of the avenging angel
questions.answer: The cup of the wine of his wrath

questions.question: Jeremiah 25 says that after seventy years God would punish the king of Babylon as well.
This whole land shall become a ruin and a waste, and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon _____ years.
Take from my hand this cup of the wine of _____, and make all the nations drink it.
